description: Inbound AI ordering and menu agent for Apetito restaurant in Slesin. Handles menu questions via searchInMenu tool, takes food orders for delivery or pickup, and provides light upsell suggestions.

tools.name: searchInMenu
tools.description: Searches the Apetito menu for items, ingredients, allergens, categories

knowledgeBase._note: Original VAPI knowledgeBase config. For transient assistants via HTTP: knowledgeBase can be passed in the model object when creating/updating an assistant via API. However, for fully transient (per-call) assistants created via the /call endpoint, knowledgeBase attachment may require the file to already exist in the VAPI org. Test whether passing knowledgeBase in the transient assistant payload works — if not, the file must be pre-uploaded and referenced by ID.

structuredDataPlan._note: KPI evaluation on every call. Schema defines 5 metrics scored by a second LLM pass on the transcript. Original config carried over — testing if VAPI still processes this correctly.

successEvaluationPlan._note: Call success evaluation based on system prompt objectives. Uses VAPI's built-in evaluation with PercentageScale rubric.

server._note: Make.com webhook for end-of-call-report, function-call, transcript events. API key in original config — do not store here.
